Card Q&A.a: You can't return a card from your trash to the hand, but you must perform "trash 1 card in your hand."
Card Q&A.q: What happens for this effect if I don't have a purple Digimon card with the [Dark Animal] trait in my trash?

Effect: [On Play][When Attacking] Return 1 purple Digimon card with the [Dark Animal] trait from your trash to the hand. Then, trash 1 card in your hand.
